answer: My answer to sybils is Signed dividend payment history from a broker — dividends a broker paid into one account for years — which makes the quill of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Fakes fail here because dividends a broker paid into one account for years is tied to something outside the network; the hollow of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the voyage of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
